fusions.name: Blood in Water
fusions.desc: A strand locks on and deals 22 damage, consuming every affliction on the target and adding 1.8 times their remaining damage. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Circling Bite
fusions.desc: A strand snaps at a target up to 6 tiles away at a cost of 5% of your maximum health, dealing 9 damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tow Line
fusions.desc: Fires a strand ahead and hauls you 5 tiles along it. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Feeding Frenzy
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
